verdict.rationale: Docs claim Claude Code can debug live web apps (Chrome), map/explain codebases via agentic search to find issues, run tests, analyze CI failures overnight, and 'verifies it works' after making changes — directly supporting reproduce/root-cause/verify workflows. However, hands-on community reports concretely contradict the verification claim: one long-term user reports a self-verification failure (a replace_all bug that silently broke a constant) and states 'You absolutely can't trust it to self-verify,' and another notes it's a better reviewer than implementer, requiring multiple rounds to fix its own work. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks on bug-reproduction accuracy, structured root-cause-analysis workflow docs, and resolution of the self-verification reliability concern.
